verdict.rationale: Poly's docs describe natural-language search inside files with results down to the page, paragraph, timestamp, or frame. Search is also available from the `poly` CLI and through visual similarity, and Poly tags exist and sync with Finder. Nothing shows search filters on tags, properties, or paths, and nothing shows search working offline. missing for 10: tag/property/path search filters, offline search capability, explicit full-text (vs. semantic) search documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of search speed.
